premise_correction.claim: docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_UPDATE.md step 6 calls 0092BE80 on the controller, assumed to be a forwarder to the controller's real update.
premise_correction.finding: 0092BE80 is a single RET 4 instruction at 0092BE80..0092BE82. It is called directly (non-virtually) from 008259DF and 00826B6A, so no override can intercept it. The unit's per-frame call into the controller does nothing; position, heading and speed are integrated by the physics library, and the controller contributes only through a force callback the library invokes.

physics_boundary.identity: Not middleware. No Havok, PhysX/NovodeX, ODE, Bullet, Meqon, Tokamak or Newton string exists in the referenced-string index, the entry points carry no strings, source paths or RTTI, and the surrounding diagnostics are Hungarian (fizika, utkozo, roncs). Treated as an in-house statically linked rigid-body library and not ported.

force_model.row_selection: variant = 2 when the unit's vtable +5Ch answers IsKindOf(8); otherwise 1 when descriptor->f_B0h < 100.0 (the double at 00d7a220), else 0. Row base 00424c40()+4E0h, stride 0x38.
force_model.curve_override: Row 1 replaces the +50Ch curve with the literal 2.0f at 00ce3958.
force_model.element_vector: descriptor+52Ch..+530h, stride 0x24, count recomputed on every iteration; an empty vector traps through 00bf6713.
force_model.submersion: above = worldPoint.y - 0078cf20(ocean, x, z); span = e[+08h]-e[+0Ch]; cap above at span, floor at 0, submerged = span - above.
force_model.curve: ratio = submerged/span; 1.0f linear, 2.0f squared, 0.5f square root; any other constant leaves the previous element's ratio in place.
force_model.scale: (descriptor->f_B0h / count) * ratio * 10.0, count converted as unsigned via the 2^32 fixup at 00ce3978, 10.0 the double at 00ce3dc0.
force_model.reverse_guard: per axis, F/v is floored at -1.0/count (00d7a250 is the double -1.0).
force_model.dead_code: EBP starts at zero (00932c1f), so every i<0 branch is unreachable: the 3.0f default span (00ce3854), the zero default range, and the whole-hull drag fallback min(settings->f_5B8h * hull_mass, settings->f_5B0h).

command_source.finding: The controller has no throttle, rudder, target speed or target heading field, and 009329c0 reads no command. Commanded force reaches the body only as an entry in the list on unit+10D4h that 0074f2e0 sums; that routine lives in the segment whose keywords include sumforces and sumleaks.
command_source.player_vs_ai: Indistinguishable at this level. The only player test in the unit update is step 7's this == DAT_00e188d8 comparison, which scales an intensity, not a command. The AI helmsman layer above the force list is named by 00818340's diagnostics (helmsmanControl, navigatorParams, thrust, thrustMod, maxSpeed, steeringJam) and was not analysed.

The body runs to the RET 4 at 009373b0 with int3 padding from 009373b5; Ghidra currently ends 00935d30 at 00936dbe and defines nothing after it.

uncertainties: The per-axis drag coefficient assignment inside the element loop is provisional.
unit+10FCh is treated as an additive mass because it is added to the hull mass; its producer was not found.
The 20 records at controller+8Ch were not decoded.
The physics library is not positively identified, only shown not to be common middleware of the era.
Curve constants other than 1.0f, 2.0f and 0.5f fall through to a stale ratio; whether any shipped settings row uses one is unknown.
Which vehicle families map to the three derived force models was not established.
The operand order handed to 004f9b30 at 00932d8b was not resolved; 009377e0 settles the sign convention as v + omega x r.

How 00937c90 walks the model's fizika_%02d nodes into bodies and shapes, and what the 20 records at controller+8Ch hold.
The three derived force callbacks and which unit families install them.
